title: Chapter 25 Building The Wall
content:
Chapter 25 Building The Wall

"I'm so charming? Some younger brothers are willing to join me?"

"Is he a liar? After all, people are evil, especially in such an environment, the evil of human nature can be easily released." Wang Shuo's mind was full of thoughts.

"Who cares? If I don't take advantage of the ready-made opportunity, I'd be a bastard. I'll talk about the future later. If I can't protect myself, I can't help others. If my strength allows, it's also a matter of convenience to help."

"How about this, I'll give you 5 gold coins for these two drawings, just as the key fee."

"Boss, I'm really honoring you with these drawings."

The two of them pushed and shoved, and finally Wang Shuo gave him 2 gold coins.

[Wall construction drawings +1, brick kiln construction drawings +1, gold coins -2]

After Wang Shuo got the drawings, he immediately learned.

[Wall: Soil + sand + water + earth bricks can make primary walls, cement + sand + water + fire bricks can make advanced walls, the number of materials depends on actual needs. 】

[Brick kiln: Use 1000 earth bricks to make a brick kiln, consume 100 coal and 5000 clay, and can make 5000 fire bricks or 20000 tiles at a time]

This is a higher grade brick than earth bricks.

Surprisingly, he also learned the "synthesis formula" of cement.

[Cement: 1 sand + 1 water + 1 lime]

He hurried to the trading house to see that no one was selling lime.

It seems that only the primary wall can be built.

But this still makes Wang Shuo in a good mood.

Thinking that there are still many buildings to build, Wang Shuo hurriedly walked outside and planned to build the buildings that can be built after unlocking.

[Front yard: 1000 earth bricks]

[Build? ]

"Yes."

I saw that the 100 square meters of ground in front of the house began to be constructed.

At this time, the heavy snow finally turned into light snow, and there were signs of clear weather.

He came to the backyard again and found that the crops in his farmland were frozen to death!

"Fuck."

You're kidding me!

Helplessly, he had to sow again.

At this time, he checked the construction of the "backyard" again.

For the backyard, you only need to build a circle of walls.

But it requires 2,000 bricks.

After thinking about it, he simply fenced the front yard as well, which would require 4,000 bricks.

He checked again and found that the materials for building the hut required 10 stones, 100 wood, and 500 bricks.

There were still several materials missing.

The price of wood and stone was almost stable at around 10 copper coins.

After all, these two materials were very basic and most players could easily obtain them.

He used another gold coin to buy 500 wood and 500 stone.

The bricks were not enough. At this moment, he still had 2,500 clay. After making all of them, there was just 100 more.

So he hurried back to make bricks.

He wanted to make fire bricks directly in the kiln, but Wang Shuo didn't have that much clay now. Considering that the beasts in the swamp were ready to move, he decided to build a primary wall first, after all, it would be an extra guarantee.

When all the materials were gathered, he immediately chose to build.

When all these were built, a whole morning was gone.

I was too tired at noon, so I went directly to Lao Zhang to order takeout.

Chef Zhang, because he has been cooking a lot recently, his cooking skills have also been upgraded, unlocking more food styles.

Now he can make fish-flavored shredded pork rice and the like.

Wang Shuo spent 24 copper coins and ordered one.

The system delivered the food, and it was like it had just come out of the pot, still steaming.

Wang Shuo took a bite, and it still tasted like home.

At this time, Wang Shuo's friend channel prompted that another player had added him as a friend.

Liu Dahai, before entering the game, was a boat owner, and fishing was a thing of the past.

He was really fed up recently.

On the third day, he got a side quest. As long as he could catch a beast-level fish, he could change his job to become a fisherman.

But beast-level fish were too hard to find, and his strength in the water had directly risen to a higher level, which could be said to have reached the level of elite monsters.

He could only make small fishing boats at present. Ordinary fishing nets could not catch them at all. Beast-level fish would break after a little struggle, so he urgently needed a high-level fishing net of excellent level.

He also listened to the advice of a friend and said that he came to Wang Shuo to try his luck, maybe he would get something.

"Boss, do you have a good-level fishing net?"

Wang Shuo thought about it. He could only make high-level fishing nets now. If his luck exploded, he could get a good-level fishing net, but luck was... hard to say!

"No." Wang Shuo replied decisively.

"Boss, can you help me think of a way? This is very important to me."

As long as he became a fisherman, his strength would usher in a huge explosion. Now it was like he had encountered a bottleneck, and it was very uncomfortable to be stuck.

After waiting for a long time, Wang Shuo didn't reply to him. He slapped his forehead and suddenly realized.

If you don't see the rabbit, don't release the eagle. There is no benefit. Who will find a way for you?

So, he sent Wang Shuo an illustration.

"Defense tower construction blueprint." This thing is of no use to Liu Dahai who wants to become a "sea king", but it is still very tempting for players living on land.

Sure enough, after a while, the other party responded.

When Wang Shuo saw this blueprint, he swallowed his saliva, he wanted it too much.

The crisis of the three tribes' encirclement and suppression could break out at any time. Wang Shuo wanted everything that could enhance combat effectiveness, so he replied:

"It is very difficult to get a high-level fishing net of excellent quality. I must use my luck once, and the price is very high."

"I understand, I understand, as long as it can succeed, no matter how high the price is, it's okay." For his dream of sailing, Liu Dahai fought hard.

"Then I'll try, but you have to provide the materials yourself, 10 copies first."

The high-level fishing net requires 10 hemp ropes.

Liu Dahai quickly traded 100 ropes.

A few minutes later, Wang Shuo traded 10 pairs of high-level fishing nets to Liu Dahai, but it didn't work.

...

20 pairs, no explosion!

30 pairs, no explosion!

At this time, Wang Shuo began to doubt whether he had no luck.

Liu Dahai's forehead was also sweating. Not to mention the materials, is his dream of sailing really going to be shattered?

Until the 39th pair, the system prompts:

[Excellent level advanced fishing net +1]

Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

He quickly clicked on the transaction. Liu Dahai was also very excited and almost forgot to put the arrow tower blueprint into the transaction box.

[Arrow tower blueprint +1]

Seeing the arrow tower blueprint in the backpack, Wang Shuo finally smiled.

After learning.

[Arrow tower: 200 wood + 10 stone + 1 energy + 1000 arrows. ]

2 arrows can be shot per second, each arrow causes 100 points of damage, and a total of 1000 arrows can be shot continuously.

This efficiency is too strong, and Wang Shuo is ecstatic.

As long as the wall is built and a few more arrow towers are built, Wang Shuo's survival rate in the face of encirclement and suppression will be greatly increased. If the golden armor warrior is made, Wang Shuo will be completely not at all.

The snow has stopped, the sky is clear, and most of the players have started to go out and collect supplies again.

Wang Shuo thought about it, but still didn't dare to go out. The swamp might be brewing a storm. If he went there now, he would be walking into a trap.

He had to quickly erect the arrow tower.
